method: Independently inspected the cloned default-branch histories using git log, show, diff --numstat, -S, and -L. Excluded used-commits.txt entries, merges, bug fixes, security changes, generated files, and candidates with later corrective changes. Counted additions plus deletions in whole code files, including embedded comments and declarations; excluded separate documentation and tests. Checked behavior changes against tests in the same commit, searched subsequent messages for reverts and feature/commit references, and inspected later relevant diffs through file migrations. Findings cover the cloned origin/HEAD tips identified below. Randomized the accepted cases with SystemRandom before assigning IDs. No files were modified.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds formatDate and FormatDateOptions as aliases of format and FormatOptions.
cases.evidence: Subject: Add alias formatDate for format function (#3653). The added test compares both functions. Checked subsequent format-file history, revert messages, and references to formatDate, #3653, and the commit through 717ce0a807ea4c6b540d015b5c408723175b2838. git log -L followed the exports into pkgs/core and traced them directly to this commit without subsequent changes; no corrective commit or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Changes the unreassigned defVal local from let to const without changing parsing behavior.
cases.evidence: Subject: refactor: let to const. Inspected the complete one-line replacement and subsequent parser history through aa386be666df974a127904020c61b9febc10301f. Pickaxe searches and line history followed defVal into lib/yargs-parser.ts, where the const binding remains; intervening changes were migration or surrounding parsing changes. Searched revert messages and commit references; no bug introduced by the binding change or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Allows YAML !!pairs entries backed by realMapTag to preserve complex keys.
cases.evidence: Subject: Support complex !!pairs keys with realMapTag. Same-commit tests cover scalar and complex keys. Inspected every later pairs.ts diff and searched pairs-related messages, commit references, and reverts through 78326247fa2cec0d2c7ed553353d554e039ee7c8. Later source changes concern documentation and tag typing; a7c9766, titled Fix !!pairs coverage, only adds a test for the already-correct multiple-key rejection. No implementation correction or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Exposes named Record factories through displayName and uses that property when describing Record instances.
cases.evidence: Subject: Give Records a displayName (#1625). Same-commit tests cover factory displayName and subclass descriptive names. Checked later Record history, declaration pickaxe searches, #1625/displayName/commit references, and revert messages through 686b8baf1dc825419f5ded2968b48e3432644aff. git log -L traces both displayName assignment and recordName lookup directly to this commit with no later functional changes; no corrective commit or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds reversePatch for inverting a structured patch or an array of structured patches.
cases.evidence: Subject: Add function to reverse a patch (#450). Added tests verify reversed output, application, and patch arrays. Checked later reverse-file history, public exports, reversePatch/#450/commit references, and revert mentions through 5947609000de10226b5f6ef2d80428eb71ed4eba. The only later implementation changes are c8a9cc5 removing the globally retired linedelimiters field and dd1c4e0 migrating to TypeScript; inversion behavior and exports remain. No bug correction or revert of this feature found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Removes a redundant array copy during diffArrays joining while retaining input copying during tokenization.
cases.evidence: Subject: Omit redundant slice in join method of diffArrays. Added anti-aliasing tests verify result chunks are distinct from input arrays. Checked all later array implementation changes, diffArrays/arrayDiff/commit references, and revert mentions through 5947609000de10226b5f6ef2d80428eb71ed4eba. The only later source commit is dd1c4e0's TypeScript rewrite; inspected its replacement and line history showing join still returns its argument. No corrective change or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds truncate to remove version components below a selected release level while discarding build metadata.
cases.evidence: Subject: feat: Add `truncate` function (#855). Same-commit tests cover release levels, invalid inputs, prereleases, metadata, and frozen SemVer inputs. Checked subsequent histories of both code files plus truncate/#855/commit references and revert messages through 6e05b7637396ac66522cff8731f07cfe0ef49a29. Neither code file changed afterward; the only named follow-up is release documentation. No fix or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Replaces a hoisted var in diff with an explicitly declared let while preserving its initialization and return behavior.
cases.evidence: Subject: refactor: replace var with let. Compared parent and commit: defaultResult remains undefined until the same conditional assignment. Checked subsequent diff.js history, pickaxe results, commit references, and revert messages through 6e05b7637396ac66522cff8731f07cfe0ef49a29. Inspected ebcf4df's const refactor and later fixes including #533, #546, and #755; these change existing prerelease algorithms rather than repair this equivalent binding replacement. No introduced bug or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds Token.attrGet to return an attribute value or null when the attribute is absent.
cases.evidence: Subject: Add an attrGet method to Token. Added tests cover missing and present attributes. Checked token-file histories, attrGet/commit references, and revert messages through 3c51991c32aaa2b002a52c009334ebe5752c84b3. git log -L followed the method through .mjs, src/, class conversion, and TypeScript migration; subsequent edits preserve the lookup behavior. No corrective commit or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds detailed parsing metadata that records which option keys received their default values.
cases.evidence: Subject: feat: options that have had their default value used are now tracked (#211). Added tests cover defaults, explicit arguments, configuration objects, and aliases. Checked later parser history, defaulted/canLog pickaxe results, #211/commit references, and revert messages through aa386be666df974a127904020c61b9febc10301f. Followed applyDefaultsAndAliases into TypeScript with git log -L; its canLog-controlled recording remains intact. No correction to this feature or revert found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Replaces Math.floor with equivalent bitwise truncation when extracting a nonnegative rounding digit modulo ten.
cases.evidence: Subject: bitwise floor ok. Inspected the surrounding rounding algorithm to verify the extracted digit is bounded below ten, so the substitution preserves behavior. Checked subsequent decimal.js history, bitwise/rounding-digit/commit references, and revert messages through b1d1e311eb272b16f5b2ca0e0d1f4c4fa8558edf. git log -L traces the current rounding expression directly to this commit without later edits; the revert found concerns README advice. No fix or revert of this refactor found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds Token.attrSet and Token.attrJoin for replacing attribute values and appending space-separated values.
cases.evidence: Subject: New .attrJoin() & .attrSet() methods in Token. Same-commit tests exercise attribute creation, replacement, and joining. Checked token-file histories, both method names, commit references, and revert messages through 3c51991c32aaa2b002a52c009334ebe5752c84b3. git log -L follows both methods through module, class, and TypeScript migrations; later changes are syntax, typing, formatting, and equivalent string interpolation. No corrective commit or revert found.
